types.name: Box3
types.doc: Positive axis-aligned finished region in millimetres.

types.name: BoxAlgebra
types.doc: Exact orthogonal box set operations. Outputs are disjoint finished volumes, not meshes.

fields.name: coalesce
fields.doc: Remove decomposition seams using exact coordinate equality.

fields.name: minimumIy
fields.doc: Exact minimum centroidal second moment about Y over X, in mm^4.

types.name: CastingBounds
types.doc: Exact bounds of axis-permuted box features. General profiles are not approximated.

types.name: CastingCavities
types.doc:
Single source of cut ∩ body. Supported envelopes are disjoint convex prisms
extruded along a coordinate axis (box, chamfered body, flared foot).

types.name: CastingDraftSections
types.doc:
Authored dimensions belong to the declared opening, never the narrow end.
This neutral construction is shared by CAD, former drawings and machining.

fields.name: unsupportedReason
fields.doc:
Capability only: invalid reached depths and collapsing offsets remain
design errors, while these unrealized axes/openings stay Unsupported.

types.name: CastingEnvelope
types.doc: Disjoint convex envelope pieces for the supported planar body family.

types.name: CastingFeature
types.doc: Design cut plus declared openings; derive the finished cavity through CastingCavities.

types.name: CastingFeatureCodec
types.doc: Strict source schema; no old box-list encoding is accepted.

fields.name: openingTargets
fields.doc: Openings name an exact source feature ID.

types.name: CastingFeatureContours
types.doc:
One finished wall contour for source CAD, former drawings and CAM. Positive
cornerRadius fillets a line polygon; an authored arc profile already carries
its exact radii and must not also request an implicit second fillet.

types.name: CastingGeometrySolid
types.doc: Insert recesses preserve their complete source exterior; design cuts stay primitive.

types.name: CastingHoleExits
types.doc:
Exact planar exit-disk/material intersection, with contact-only faces excluded.
Sections use the authoritative finished cavities; no design cut is clipped here.

types.name: CastingInput
types.doc:
An input is either supplied or explicitly unresolved. Design-rule limits
remain ordinary numbers; this type carries missing accuracy/evidence inputs.

types.name: CastingInterfaceContext
types.doc:
Facts copied from the machine assembly, expressed in the casting body's
source coordinates. External references remain external; no target geometry,
tolerance, relationship or machine axis is invented by the tooling planner.

types.name: CastingLiftingPoint
types.doc:
A source lifting attachment is a particular steel thread, not an insert.
Several attachments may share one plate; fixture and anchor holes are never
promoted to lifting points by their diameter, label or array order.

types.name: CastingOpening
types.doc: Body-face targets are <body ID>.<x-min|x-max|y-min|y-max|z-min|z-max>.

types.name: CastingPatterns
types.doc: Shared design patterns. Cuts carry design intent; openings are explicit.

fields.name: grid
fields.signature: (width:Float, depth:Float, height:Float, wall:Float, sole:Float, roof:Float, rib:Float, ?columns:Int, ?rows:Int):Array<CastingFeature>

types.name: CastingPolygons
types.doc: Exact line intersections; tolerance is used only for coincident geometry.

types.name: CastingPrism
types.doc: Convex planar envelope / exact line-profile cavity piece. Local +Z extrusion.

types.name: CastingPrismSection
types.doc: Whole-solid prism proven by the geometry backend, including holes/islands.

types.name: CastingProfileCodec
types.doc: Strict neutral records. The containing feature owns schema versioning.

types.name: CastingProfileGeometry
types.doc: Exact line/circle predicates. No tessellation and no cutter compensation.

fields.name: tangent
fields.doc: Oriented derivative at a line/arc endpoint; magnitude is immaterial.

fields.name: minimumInternalRadius
fields.doc:
Smallest internal stock-corner radius of a CCW removed region.
Tangent authored arcs retain their real radius; a sharp inward corner is
zero, and a re-entrant corner is not an internal stock corner.

fields.name: distanceBetween
fields.doc: Exact line/arc minimum boundary distance, including interior stationary points.

types.name: CastingProfileOffsets
types.doc:
Parallel wall sections for draft and core covering. This changes finished geometry; it is not
router compensation. A positive distance moves the contour into its interior.
Topology changes (vanishing arcs, reversed edges, crossing walls) are errors.

fields.name: outward
fields.doc: Grow an internal foam opening to preserve lining around retained material.

types.name: CastingProfiles
types.doc: Exact closed profiles, without cutter compensation or tessellation.

fields.name: placed
fields.doc: Rigid 2D placement preserves exact arcs, including their signed sweep.

fields.name: roundedPolygon
fields.doc:
Circular fillets of a line polygon, including re-entrant corners. Adjacent
tangency distances must fit their common edge; overlapping fillets fail.
The exact arcs returned here are shared by CAD, drawings and CAM.

fields.name: referencePath
fields.doc: Assembly instance paths qualify local IDs without allowing empty or parent segments.

types.name: CastingRegion
types.doc:
Exact finished-region expression. Bounds are stock/layout data only; these
operations are evaluated by the geometry backend, without box substitution.

types.name: CastingRegionBounds
types.doc:
Conservative bounds for blanks and broad-phase checks only. A boolean
region's bounds never substitute for its material, cavity or displaced volume.

types.name: CastingRegionCodec
types.doc:
Strict expression records; the containing document owns its schema version.
Commutative operands have canonical order. Size/depth budgets apply across
the whole tree, including typed enum inputs, before recursive serialization.

types.name: CastingSection
types.doc: Exact filled section in a declared plane; shared by drawing and CAM bridges.

types.name: CastingSectionBand
types.doc: Exact constant-profile interval; its complete extrusion is proved against the solid.

types.name: CastingSegment
types.doc:
Directed exact curve. An arc stores its centre and signed sweep; a line
stores null/zero. A circle uses two distinct-ended half arcs.

types.name: CastingSolid
types.doc:
Solid primitive in its own frame: centred in XY, from Z=0 to height.
Insert bodies and design cuts share this geometry. Insert holes remain separate.
A cylinder is exact geometry, never its bounding box for box-only analysis.

types.name: CastingSolidCodec
types.doc: One neutral encoding for solid primitives. The containing document owns versioning.

fields.name: box
fields.doc: Explicit box-only gate; never projects a round body onto a rectangular one.

types.name: CastingTextInput
types.doc: Text evidence uses the same states, with a concrete wire-safe value type.

types.name: EmbeddedAnchors
types.doc:
Derived source occupancy, copied from the owning inserts when a foundation
is built. It is never a second independent anchor layout or a box substitute.

fields.name: moments
fields.doc:
Exact nominal cylinder/external-hex moments of the declared hardware.
exposedOnly removes the shank portion inside the rectangular steel blank;
otherwise returns the metal added to the steel union (thread-envelope
overlap is counted once). Callers qualify containment with source CAD.

fields.name: SolidIntersection
fields.doc: Exact cut/body expression; native realization must also validate openings.

types.name: FixtureConstraint
types.doc:
One contact direction in the insert's common fixture frame. Source IDs trace
to the planned pads, pin/hole or slot contacts; a clamp is preload, not a datum.

types.name: FixtureConstraints
types.doc:
Infinitesimal six-DOF location check. Rows are n·(t + rotation × lever).
Rotation coordinates are scaled by the declared reference length before
elimination; output converts them back to radians. This is a location/rank
check, not proof of preload, strength, pour access or post-cure removal.

types.name: FoundationDatumGeometry
types.doc:
Nominal reference-frame consistency, in source coordinates. These numerical
tolerances are identity checks, not manufacturing tolerances or proof that a
physical contact patch is available after cutting, lining or finishing.

types.name: FoundationDatumSources
types.doc: Source-provided reference inventory, not a second geometry representation.

fields.name: ordered
fields.doc: Datum order is semantic and never sorted alphabetically.

fields.name: sourceInventory
fields.doc:
Resolve IDs against the source's exact supported boundary records. This does
not qualify the availability or accuracy of a physical datum contact patch.
Non-prismatic feature boundaries stay explicitly unresolved, never boxified.

types.name: FoundationJoint
types.doc:
Finished assembly design, not a mold process option. Missing declarations
remain missing; gaps and tolerances are always resolved design numbers.
Physical cure evidence and joint strength belong to process qualification.

types.name: FoundationJointAnalysis
types.doc:
Shared source-reference resolver and nominal geometry checks. Results are
recomputed from facts, never accepted as evidence encoded in a source file.

types.name: FoundationJointBody
types.doc:
Facts copied from source components, in the foundation snapshot's frame.
Each component occurs once even when several joints reference it.

types.name: FoundationJointReference
types.doc:
Assembly-scoped source interface or hole, never a display label. The field
using the reference determines whether it must resolve to a plane or a bore.

fields.name: remap
fields.doc: Definition IDs remain local. Every assembly-member reference is remapped.

types.name: HoleClearanceBudget
types.doc:
Manufacturing error allocations, separate from the numeric hole design limits.
In-plane magnitudes refer to the insert XY datum origin; the angular term
acts over each hole's actual radial distance from that origin.
Unresolved values identify missing accuracy inputs, never thread-policy limits.

fields.name: assess
fields.doc:
Worst-case vector magnitudes add; no statistical independence is assumed.
Rotation contributes the chord displacement from the actual datum lever arm.
Transfer drilling removes casting placement, adjustment, bow and pitch error;
its drill/guide error and the required clearance margin still apply.

types.name: InsertAnchorRules
types.doc:
Limits are source design rules, not unverified evidence or implicit defaults.
Embedment and cover refer to the surrounding casting's exposed boundary and
must be qualified with that geometry, not estimated from the insert thickness.

types.name: InsertAnchorScreen
types.doc:
Exact primitive screen against finite planar boundary faces. Edges are the
actual trimmed face edges, including inner loops. No mesh or pose sampling.
Native CAD confirms the one selected complete pattern.

fields.name: accepts
fields.signature: (point:InsertBackAnchorChoice, screw:InsertAnchorScrew, stockZ:Float, pose:AssemblyFrame, faces:Array<AnchorFace>, cover:Float, minimumEmbedment:Float):Bool

types.name: InsertAnchorScrew
types.doc:
ISO 4162 Type F class 8.8 hardware facts copied from the standard component.
The assembly preload is a steel-side sizing limit, never mix capacity.

fields.name: sourceDemandRule
fields.doc:
Named source rule shared by the mill and hobber. This is a demand-side
design choice; compound capacity still requires the declared material data.
Return fresh records so one source cannot mutate another's recipe.

fields.name: liftingPositions
fields.doc:
The same CoM-based source locations used by the castability proposals.
They propose attachment positions, not rigging or compound capacity.

fields.name: select
fields.signature: (spec:InsertSpec, rule:InsertAnchorPatternRule, demand:InsertAnchorDemand, choices:Array<InsertAnchorStockChoice>, failures:Array<String>, admit:(InsertAnchorCandidate) -> Bool):InsertAnchorCandidate

types.name: InsertAnchorStockChoice
types.doc:
Resolved catalogue facts enter from the native source adapter. Selection and
candidate order depend only on these neutral records and the declared rules.

types.name: InsertAnchorageChecks
types.doc: Source geometry/rules are independent of pull-out capacity and process evidence.

fields.name: materialChecks
fields.doc:
Elementary force = stress x area. The 45-degree cone and equal load
sharing are explicit in-house screening assumptions, not EN 1992-4 or a
concrete-anchor certification. Exact circle union removes double-counted
overlap; no empirical edge/group factor is introduced.

fields.name: projectedConeUnionArea
fields.doc:
Exact projected circle-union area from exposed circular arcs (Green's
theorem). This handles multiple/triple overlaps without pairwise area
subtraction, sampling or an interaction coefficient.

types.name: InsertBlank
types.doc: A stock selection is a source design choice, not evidence of delivered stock.

types.name: InsertBlankFit
types.doc:
Exact containment for primitive stock. Vertex tests are exact for a convex
box inside convex stock; cylinder supports are analytic, never box volumes.

fields.name: planarEndFrames
fields.doc:
Exact planar end frames, positive end first. A crimped tail is not a
second planar receiver. Frames describe the source body without changing
its geometry or the authored hole coordinates.

fields.name: mouth
fields.doc: Mouth span only; this is not a bounding-box approximation of the insert.

types.name: InsertBoreRelief
types.doc: Enlarged blind bore beyond a short entry thread, continuing to hole depth.

types.name: InsertCrimpedTail
types.doc: Product retention geometry belongs to an insert, never to a casting cut primitive.

types.name: InsertFinishedSteel
types.doc: Geometry only: a replicated layer is not steel and has no invented material.

types.name: InsertFinishing
types.doc:
One exact stock-to-service realization. Plane removals constrain the finished
box; replication thickness is measured from that finished steel, not raw stock.
All coordinates remain in the insert's authored frame.

types.name: InsertHole
types.doc:
Source entry frame and depths refer to finished steel. Raw manufacturing
states derive extensions through finishing stock without moving service holes.

fields.name: threadLimits
fields.doc: Thread-only design rules are absent on plain bores, never unknown on taps.

types.name: InsertHoleGeometry
types.doc: Exact stock geometry and mass properties for neutral hole patterns.

fields.name: radialWall
fields.doc: Actual radial stock beside drilling, including counterbore and thread relief.

fields.name: massProperties
fields.signature: (width:Float, depth:Float, height:Float, holes:Array<InsertHole>):{volume:Float, center:{x:Float, y:Float, z:Float}}
fields.doc: Exact insert volume and centroid for disjoint axial drilling patterns.

types.name: InsertInspection
types.doc:
Limits are authored numbers when the inspection is declared. An absent
inspection remains a missing requirement; it never becomes a zero tolerance.

types.name: InsertManufacturing
types.doc:
Fabricated-insert manufacturing choices. Operations are derived from these
choices and the owning insert's body/holes/interfaces, without storing a second
copy of its geometry. The enclosing source document fingerprints all of them.

fields.name: draft
fields.doc: A complete typed draft with no invented stock, hole route or inspection limit.

types.name: InsertMaterial
types.doc: Stock condition is part of the design, not inferred by the tooling adapter.

types.name: InsertMountHoleRequirement
types.doc:
A source mounting-hole interface: permissions and accuracy allocations are
independent of the precision face's finishing route. The hole owns its entry
frame (+Z into steel); the placed bought part's connector supplies its
nominal +Y axis lineage, following the assembly connector convention.

fields.name: references
fields.doc:
Validate lineage, without changing the one stored hole frame. These are
numerical checks of nominal source geometry, not physical accuracy evidence.

types.name: InsertOrigin
types.doc: Product identity is separate from its display label and geometry evidence.

types.name: InsertRoles
types.doc: Typed role vocabulary shared by source schemas and neutral validation.

types.name: InsertSpec
types.doc:
One source contract for rectangular and round inserts. `body` is the
pre-cast steel envelope, including declared finishing stock. Hole frames and
usable depths describe the finished steel in the same authored coordinates.
InsertFinishing and InsertStages derive physical states; neither is stored as
a second source design. Replicated layers are separate from steel material.

types.name: InsertSpecCodec
types.doc: Source and tooling use the same body and holes; document codecs own versions.

types.name: InsertStage
types.doc:
Physical construction state. The source body contains its declared stock;
hole frames and usable depths describe the finished steel.

fields.name: rawGeometryForServiceHoles
fields.doc:
Geometric projection only, with no manufacturing permission implied.
Fixture feasibility may inspect an existing un-staged service hole without
inventing a source route or changing its budget-controlled declaration.

fields.name: validateServiceHole
fields.doc:
Check the service material, not the disposable stock, against the source
engagement, back-wall and radial-wall rules. No rule is replaced by a default.

types.name: InsertThreadCodec
types.doc: Shared nominal thread encoding for source bores and real external screws.

types.name: InsertThreadHand
types.doc: Drilling frame +Z points into the insert from its entry face.

types.name: InterfaceMember
types.doc:
Component paths name the part owning the interface; machine axes name joints.
Both can be qualified when an assembly is nested, without interpreting labels.

types.name: InterfaceRelationshipKind
types.doc:
Geometric relations use the member's actual kind: plane-line parallelism
means a perpendicular plane normal and line direction; plane-line squareness
means parallel normal and direction. Normals are not substituted for planes.

fields.name: validateReferences
fields.doc:
Resolve both directions of the source/assembly contract. A relationship must
name existing interfaces and each participating interface must reference it.
This checks declarations only, never measured alignment or uncertainty.

fields.name: remapMembers
fields.doc: Definition ID remains stable in source requirements; only physical member paths move.

fields.name: uncertaintyMargin
fields.doc: Null is missing physical evidence; a negative value cannot qualify the relationship.

types.name: InterfaceRequirements
types.doc:
Defensive source records, with no CAD handles or process evidence. The owning
casting document versions these embedded records together with its source geometry.

fields.name: fixtureBudgetMm
fields.doc: Remaining combined fixture/casting/metrology budget; no geometric use.

types.name: InterfaceRoute
types.doc: The design owns the route; tooling chooses only one of its permitted finishes.

types.name: InterfaceStockResult
types.doc:
Verified nominal layer over the complete matched stock face, in insert coordinates. Hole manufacturing, finishing
process capability and physical inspection are separate qualifications.

types.name: PostCureBond
types.doc:
Receiver drilling belongs to the finished casting, never the pour cavity.
insertId names the separately itemised steel installed after cure.

types.name: PrecisionGeometry
types.doc:
A plane uses frame +Z as normal; a straight reference edge uses frame +X.
Frames describe the finished design interface, in the owning part's coordinates.

types.name: RelationshipTolerance
types.doc:
Angular budgets retain their declared measurement length rather than silently
interpreting micrometres per 300 mm as an absolute position tolerance.

fields.name: PerLength
fields.doc:
Lateral rise over a gage span measured along the ideal reference direction;
its angular slope is maxDeviationMm/spanMm (tan of the allowed angle).

types.name: ScopedInterfaceRequirement
types.doc: The assembly supplies ownership; interface names are local to their source.

types.name: ThreadedFastenerFit
types.doc:
Shared nominal interval checks for actual source screws and selected fixture
stock. Callers establish matching thread specifications; this function checks
placement, full-thread overlap, smooth shank and the source tip-gap limits.
It does not establish physical strength, torque or manufacturing evidence.

types.name: SheetCut
types.doc: A full straight cut through one current rectangular region.

types.name: SheetCutExecution
types.doc: Immutable audit record of one confirmed cut operation. Areas are in mm².

types.name: SheetCutPlan
types.doc: Authored cutting layout, separate from physical inventory and execution history.

types.name: SheetFreeLayout
types.doc: Independent polygon validation for version-2 free-form layouts; no nesting heuristic is trusted here.

types.name: SheetInventory
types.doc: Local, atomic inventory workflow for registering, allocating, previewing and executing cuts.

fields.name: registerSheet
fields.doc: Registration changes inventory only after the complete candidate record validates.

fields.name: editPlan
fields.doc: Persist a manual layout edit and advance its plan revision.

fields.name: editRequirement
fields.doc: Persist changed part requirements. Existing plan fingerprints then report as stale.

fields.name: revalidatePlan
fields.doc: Accept current stock and part revisions as the new basis for a cut plan.

fields.name: preview
fields.doc: Preview is side-effect free and recomputes every material, dimension, and cut check.

fields.name: execute
fields.doc: Confirmed execution consumes the allocated source and creates all outputs in one atomic save.

types.name: SheetPartPlacement
types.doc: Coordinates are measured from the lower-left corner of the full sheet, in plan units.

types.name: SheetPartRequirement
types.doc: A designed part's rectangular cutting blank and acceptable stock.

types.name: SheetPlanExporter
types.doc: CSV cut list and SVG planning drawing. Exports require a currently valid cut plan.

types.name: SheetPlanValidator
types.doc:
Pure rectangular sheet-plan validation and guillotine-cut geometry. All result dimensions
are normalized to millimetres. Plan coordinates use a lower-left origin on the full sheet.
The numerical acceptance tolerance is 1e-7 mm for coordinates and max(1e-6 mm²,
sourceArea × 1e-9) for area balance.

types.name: SheetPolygon
types.doc: Polygonal layouts in mm on a 1 µm grid. Predicates use exact integer products within the bounded domain.

types.name: SheetProjectCodec
types.doc: Versioned JSON codec for authored sheet plans and separate physical inventory history.

types.name: SheetProjectRecord
types.doc: Versioned manufacturing project. Plans are design records; pieces and executions are inventory.

types.name: SheetStockSpec
types.doc: Reusable purchased-sheet description. Dimensions use `lengthUnit`.

types.name: StockPiece
types.doc: One physical sheet or reusable remnant. Its measured dimensions use `lengthUnit`.

types.name: CoreWireAxis
types.doc:
Initial manufacturing inputs; panel joints and load models are added with their planners.
All lengths are mm. Evidence references record provenance, not automatic qualification.

types.name: FixtureReceiver
types.doc: Coplanar steel can use the real shell face; raised faces still need datums.

types.name: ReleaseFace
types.doc:
A native geometry query supplies the contact area, never a hand-entered list.
Sealing treats the complete exposed board face; release treats its wetted
portion only. Dry faces may need sealing without receiving mold release.

types.name: ReleaseSystem
types.doc:
One declared process, shared by every geometrically wetted tooling face.
Product selection and manufacturer times may remain unresolved shop inputs.
A declaration of EPS safety never substitutes for a physical coupon trial.

fields.name: unresolved
fields.doc:
Examples declare coat counts; actual products and their datasheet times
remain shop inputs. There are no library defaults for these choices.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.doc: Raw records only. Typed copies explicitly pass through record().

fields.name: missing
fields.doc: Missing inputs are gathered from typed states, never field-name reflection.

types.name: ToolingCodec
types.doc:
Strict, detached and deterministic records. No native geometry or inventory effects.
Named collections are sorted by ID; profile vertices retain their geometric order.
Inputs are explicitly millimetres; other units require conversion before this boundary.

fields.name: encodeInput
fields.doc: Persist source geometry once when a native source component needs no mold setup.

fields.name: copy
fields.doc: Accepts typed records through exactly the same validation as decoded JSON.

fields.name: canonical
fields.doc: Sort object keys as well as named records so field construction order is irrelevant.

types.name: ToolingDiagnostic
types.doc: Stable rule and subject IDs let later CAD and process checks share one report.

types.name: ToolingDocument
types.doc:
Authored manufacturing inputs, separate from sheet plans and inventory.
Schema version and format are supplied by ToolingCodec's outer envelope.

types.name: ToolingIds
types.doc: IDs share one ASCII vocabulary across source and generated tooling records.

fields.name: derive
fields.doc: Reserve suffix space without losing source identity when an ID is long.

types.name: ToolingReadiness
types.doc: Qualification is separate from successful planning and CAD reconstruction.

types.name: ToolingReview
types.doc: Input-contract review only. Passing the codec never establishes fabrication readiness.

types.name: CastHandling
types.doc:
Exact box moments retain their algebraic path. Non-box source geometry
uses the application kernel, with results expressed in mm/kg.

fields.name: resinVolume
fields.doc:
Resin quantity of the complete source casting. Cavities retain their exact
regions; anchor hardware outside the steel blank displaces mix as well.
Stock/layout bounds never enter this material calculation.

fields.name: moments
fields.doc: Existing source mass calculation shared by handling and lifting proposals.

fields.name: liftingIds
fields.doc:
Source attachment declarations are distinct from equipment qualification.
Anchor holes are occupied and post-cast holes do not yet exist at the lift.

types.name: CastingBoxSupport
types.doc: Box-only consumers qualify the exact derived cavities before projecting any region.

types.name: CastingCoreUnit
types.doc: One exact source core intent and its physical foam membership.

types.name: CastingMoldAssessment
types.doc: Source assessment can decline geometry without manufacturing a box stand-in.

types.name: CastingMoldKernel
types.doc:
An application supplies exact boolean geometry for the non-box planning
path. ManufacturingKit stays independent of CAD libraries. The orthogonal
path retains its existing exact algebra and does not need this service.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Actual extrema for manufacturing stock selection, after all subtractions.

fields.name: prismaticSection
fields.doc:
A candidate section is accepted only when its complete extrusion has
symmetric difference within tolerance of the source solid. Null means
the source is not a representable line/arc prism along this direction.

fields.name: prismaticBands
fields.doc: Geometry bands only; machining access and wire-stock limits remain separate.

fields.name: resinIntersections
fields.doc:
True interior intersections with one source resin solid, clipped at the
declared fill plane. Results retain query order; no qualification is cached.

types.name: CastingMoldPlanner
types.doc:
Orthogonal review template for multiple explicit EPS/former strategies.
All casting dimensions come from the source document. It never adds design cuts.

fields.name: geometry
fields.doc: Application-owned exact kernel. A pure box-only process leaves it unset.

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.doc: Construction identity includes the source and its declared or recipe-derived choices.

fields.name: shellBounds
fields.doc: Shell stock bounds only. Material queries use MoldRegions.envelope.

fields.name: insertStockBounds
fields.doc: Layout/stock bounds only; material ownership uses MoldRegions.insert.

fields.name: ownershipOrder
fields.doc: Ownership ordering accepts raw caller order, before codec canonicalisation.

fields.name: box
fields.doc: Single-pocket construction: the individual bridge or routed bed socket.

types.name: CastingRegionMoments
types.doc:
Geometric moments in mm: first moments are zero for empty material. These
are design-geometry results, not physical capacity or qualification evidence.

types.name: CastingSetup
types.doc:
Mold +Z is upward, gravity is -Z and the open fill face faces +Z.
The setup is tied to the exact input fingerprint, not merely its revision number.

types.name: CastingSourceRegions
types.doc: One source-to-analysis projection. Unsupported geometry has no box substitute.

types.name: CastingStrategies
types.doc: Source intent and recipe rules choose tooling; source axes select withdrawal.

types.name: CastingToolingInput
types.doc:
A detached, machine-independent design snapshot. Right-handed source coordinates.
No draft, core strategy, anchorage qualification or finishing allowance is inferred.

types.name: CastingToolingInsert
types.doc:
Neutral insert exterior and source drilling patterns, in mm.
Local +Z identifies the mounting-face normal, at the body's height.

types.name: CoreStockSpec
CoreSupports
types.doc: Two explicit support templates; neither establishes adhesive or structural qualification.

fields.name: prismCutting
fields.doc:
A line/arc prism is ruled exactly along its extrusion. Orient that axis
onto the declared stock wire axis; bounds describe only the blank. The
caller selects stock and layers, without applying kerf compensation.

fields.name: socketFrame
fields.doc:
The existing routed-foot construction in the receiving panel's frame.
+Z points into the cavity; the panel material is below Z0 in this frame.

fields.name: socketFoot
fields.signature: (c:CastingMoldCore, foam:{x:Float, y:Float, width:Float, depth:Float}, cavityContact:{x:Float, y:Float, width:Float, depth:Float}, baseZ:Float, contactZ:Float, r:ToolingRecipe, bed:PanelPlacement, penetrations:Array<PenetrationPlan>):Void
fields.doc:
The receiver is sized from a certified contact rectangle, independently of
the rest of a branched EPS core. Neither rectangle is a material surrogate.

fields.name: insertCarrier
fields.doc:
Dry cross-carrier, supported on faced board pads over the wall tops.
Pads use the existing former stock/machining route; external end clamps
and board capacity retain the existing closure qualification requirement.

types.name: DatumFixtureLocation

fields.name: onPanel
fields.doc:
Contact witnesses stay inside a rectangle proved in the finished panel
outline. Cut bounds exclude any witness that a real operation might remove.
The support bounding prism is only a witness-search domain, not panel CAD.

types.name: DatumFixtures
types.doc:
Nominal supports, located by pins and clamped into source steel threads.
Loose pins/screws/masks must be released before the solid-only removal graphs.
No source insert thread or pin hole is invented.

fields.name: panelOnFace
fields.doc:
Match an authored mounting plane to a real shell contact plane. The
subsequent contact and penetration checks prove the footprint and holes.

fields.name: contactSurface
fields.doc: Shared finished contact plane, including a routed receiver floor.

fields.name: add
fields.signature: (p:CastingMoldPlan, i:CastingToolingInsert, face:materia.assembly.AssemblyRecord.AssemblyFrame, datum:MoldVolume, withdrawal:{x:Float, y:Float, z:Float}, bed:PanelPlacement, ?pocketId:String):Void

fields.name: addPanel
fields.doc:
One direct receiver for a bed, wall or dry carrier. Every source-facing
mask has a clearance access hole, so release never needs a resin-side
counterbore or a thread invented in the tooling.

fields.name: validatePanelSeal
fields.doc: Check an insert-covered panel bore before any native CAD is built.

types.name: EPSAccessNetworks
types.doc:
Connected EPS cuts can share a declared opening. A service branch does not
need a new breakout merely because its own cut is inside the body. This box
path never substitutes a stock envelope for curved material.

fields.name: add
fields.doc: Existing routed-foot construction, sized from the actual receiver section.

fields.name: contactRectangle
fields.doc:
A locating foot needs a real rectangular patch, not the bounds of an
entire branched section. Grid cells are certified against exact line/arc
contours; hole bounds conservatively exclude contact without changing foam.

fields.name: solidStock
fields.doc:
Smallest sufficient declared sheet, independent of declaration order.
Returning null selects the panel-box construction, never a laminated block.

types.name: FormerConstructionPlan
types.doc:
The envelope is the existing cavity-shaping former. Construction describes
its board material separately, including the open interior of a panel box.

types.name: FormerCutter
types.doc:
Board choices and cutter dimensions are recipe inputs, never planner defaults.
Lengths are mm. A zero taper is the ordinary straight router cutter.

types.name: FormerMachiningPlan
types.doc:
Native section extraction supplies these neutral records. CamKit owns
compensation and consumes exactly these same line/arc contours.

types.name: FoundationJointProcess
types.doc: Process choices do not override the source assembly joint geometry.

types.name: FoundationJointQualification
types.doc:
Source intent and recomputed nominal checks are separate from joint process
evidence. No material name or cure-reference string alone releases a joint.

types.name: InsertFixturePlanner
types.doc: All mold constructions use the same source-thread access and axial depth budget.

fields.name: requiredPostWidth
fields.doc:
The declared stock width is a minimum. Source-thread clearance and the
existing primary/secondary pin ligaments determine the usable datum post.

fields.name: mountingFace
fields.doc:
Reuse only source threads. Prefer an actual panel receiver, then a
bed-facing end; equal choices keep the authored positive-end convention.
An unresolved hole route may nominate a face but never becomes a fixing.

fields.name: plate
fields.doc:
Reusable two-plate datum carrier. Only source holes facing the plate are used.
Screw lengths are selected from declared stock after the complete depth budget.
This constructs no thread in tooling and makes no fixture-accuracy claim.

fields.name: threadStart
fields.doc: Entry depth before full teeth begin, in the source hole's own frame.

fields.name: facing
fields.doc: Hole +Z points into steel; support-face +Z points out of steel.

fields.name: select
fields.signature: (hole:InsertHole, insertToMold:AssemblyFrame, supportFace:AssemblyFrame, hardware:ToolingHardware):Null<{entry:AssemblyFrame, engagement:Float, insertion:Float, clearanceDiameter:Float, plug:Null<{diameter:Float, length:Float, materialSpec:String}>}>

types.name: InsertManufacturingPlan
types.doc:
Source choices generate the shop sequence. An undecided hole produces no
drilling operation; neither geometry nor a fixture screw decides its route.

types.name: InsertQualifications
types.doc: Product provenance survives every planner; nominal geometry data never clears readiness.

types.name: InterfaceQualification
types.doc:
A measurement-chain budget check, independent of measured geometry and
instrument acceptance. Passing this rule does not qualify a precision interface.

fields.name: finishingStock
fields.doc:
Geometry-only decision. A pass does not qualify hole finishing, the selected
machining process, bonding, a replication dam or physical inspection.

fields.name: replicationRequirement
fields.doc:
Process prerequisites follow the source interface routes. An identified
master/release does not establish material, metrology or physical evidence.

types.name: MoldAssemblyPlanner
types.doc: Neutral manufacturing plan. CAD supplies checked sweeps; presentations only adapt this explicit record.

fields.name: build
fields.signature: (p:CastingMoldPlan, sweep:ToolingSweepReport, motions:Array<{id:String, x:Float, y:Float, z:Float}>, groups:Array<{id:String, members:Array<String>}>):MoldAssemblyPlan

fields.name: order
fields.doc: Deterministic dependency order, preferring accessible box construction and promptly securing located parts.

types.name: MoldCoreDrafts
types.doc: Supported ruled draft intent, proven against the whole finished cavity.

types.name: MoldCoreLayers
types.doc: Exact ruled cores, with lining and explicit glue gaps between stock pieces.

fields.name: registeredFlange
fields.doc:
An EPS access former retains the already-proved neck and flange geometry.
Erosion uses the profile metric times the withdrawal-axis interval. Across
a step, intersect every neighbouring eroded section within covering reach;
internal stock boundaries therefore receive glue, never spurious lining.

fields.name: network
fields.doc: A connected source-void unit shares one declared bed or fill access.

types.name: MoldCores
types.doc: Finished foam and gross cavity occupancy are distinct from cutting stock.

fields.name: occupied
fields.doc:
Gross exclusion includes the foot's two declared glue lines. Otherwise
backing allocation would put a wood shim between the foot and its core.

fields.name: singlePocketRecord
fields.doc:
The delivered single-pocket cutting sheet keeps its shop layout while the
allocation uses the common region/layer/support records in memory.

fields.name: cuttingJobs
fields.doc: All wire-cut stock supplied for a core, including its separate glued foot.

fields.name: assemblyAnchor
fields.doc:
Keep the logical core ID on its bed-facing or carrier-facing stock piece.
Other pieces keep their cutting IDs. Thus existing core references remain
physical members while in-mold stock has separate checked approaches.

fields.name: bridgeAssemblyMembers
fields.doc: These top stock pieces really bond to the dry carrier before installation.

fields.name: carrier
fields.doc:
The carrier follows the finished top footprint, including retained-material
openings. Stock bounds position its drawing; they are never its outline.

fields.name: stockBounds
fields.doc: Layout/blank bounds only: never material or displacement.

fields.name: OnDatum
fields.signature: (volume:MoldVolume, withdrawal:{x:Float, y:Float, z:Float}, lateralLocation:{primaryId:String, secondaryId:String, baselineMm:Float})

types.name: MoldFixtures
types.doc: Access explicit support variants; a direct panel fixture has no independent volume.

types.name: MoldFormerAccess
types.doc:
Source-section access through a planar panel wall. Source dimensions remain
finished geometry; cutter compensation belongs to CamKit.

fields.name: registeredBedAccess
fields.doc:
Bed access lives entirely outside the source envelope. A rectangular
removable neck can therefore include front-face backing without rounding
or enlarging the casting cavity. It uses the existing relieved profile.

types.name: MoldOpenings
types.doc:
One canonical opening table. Physical penetration records are read-only
compositions for sealing checks, not a second stored plan or encoding.

types.name: MoldOptions
types.doc: Strict authored process inputs. Missing physical evidence stays explicit, never inferred.

types.name: MoldPanelReceivers
types.doc:
Proud raw steel sits in a routed shell-panel rebate. The matched cured closure fills
the cutter relief and clearance, so no resin-side gap is silently ignored.

fields.name: datum
fields.doc:
Cure the actual clearance/relief around a dry-fitted datum. Its drilled
holes remain dry access passages, not compound-filled receiver volume.

types.name: MoldPanels
types.doc: Shared removable five-panel shell; no feature classification or machine dimensions.

fields.name: formerBox
fields.doc:
Outward-facing removable former shell. Unlike the mold walls, its cap
and four sides stay within the authored exterior. The withdrawal end is
open. Two cap rebates and four corner rebates locate the sides; closure
uses pocket screws with heads and access inside the dry cavity.
Board/grip qualification remains a physical shop input.

types.name: MoldRegions

fields.name: insert
fields.doc:
Full source steel envelope, including protected bores during the pour.
Stock bounds never replace cylindrical or catalogue retention geometry.

fields.name: tooling
fields.doc:
Single finished tooling expression from the same operation profiles used
by panel CAD, drawings and CAM. Exact cuts are never replaced by bounds.

types.name: MoldSeal
types.doc: Cured closure material remains attached to its receiver panel.

types.name: MoldVolumeBounds
types.doc:
Conservative occupied boxes for loads/broad-phase checks. Curved profiles use
their complete bounds and cuts are deliberately not credited as displaced volume.
Never use these boxes to assert exact reconstruction or collision.

types.name: OpeningProtection
types.doc: Special sealing details belong to the same opening as its coverage record.

types.name: ReplicationJigCodec
types.doc:
Authored process geometry, never a second design interface or tolerance.
Records alone do not qualify rigidity, support hardware or measured alignment.

types.name: ReplicationJigs
types.doc:
Explicit jig inventory and prerequisites. Numeric support and reference checks
never stand in for rigidity, contact coverage or measured relationship evidence.

types.name: ReplicationPlacement
types.doc:
A conservative analytic bound on nominal master placement, not a contact,
flatness, metrology or physical relationship qualification. Angular error is
evaluated over the recorded plane/edge stock or the source's declared axis spans.
Every acceptance limit comes from the source; no fixture accuracy is assumed.

fields.name: stockRadius
fields.doc:
Farthest distance from the contact-reference origin to the stock. Boxes
use the exact corner extrema of a convex norm; cylinders use radial support
and the farthest cap analytically. This is a bound, not sampled CAD coverage.

types.name: ReplicationRelationships
ResolvedFeatureStrategy
types.doc: Directions are expressed in mold coordinates, never source coordinates.

types.name: ToolingHardwareMembers
types.doc: Shared occurrence contract for the planner and the CAD fastener producer.

types.name: ToolingSweepReport
types.doc: Geometry observations supplied by the CAD sweep checker to neutral manufacturing planners.

types.name: FabricationSpecs
types.doc: Validate and copy the in-memory shop inputs; no independent storage format.

types.name: PlateSupport
types.doc: Declared load/material inputs. Evidence is tied to this package's input fingerprint.

types.name: ToolingFabrication
types.doc: Pure fabrication inputs and reports. No CAD, CAM, drawing writers or inventory mutations.

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: Deterministic shelf layout of bounding blanks; not a contour nest or executable sheet inventory plan.

types.name: ToolingLoads
types.doc: Baseline liquid pressure; conservative peak-pressure structural demand, not paste flow.

fields.name: plate
fields.signature: (p:Float, a:Float, b:Float, t:Float, e:Float, nu:Float, ?terms:Int):{deflectionMm:Float, stressPa:Float}
fields.doc:
Navier odd Fourier series for an isotropic, four-edge simply-supported rectangle under uniform p.
Returns centre deflection and maximum centre bending stress. Cutouts/orthotropy are unsupported.

fields.name: beam
fields.signature: (p:Float, span:Float, tributary:Float, width:Float, depth:Float, e:Float):{deflectionMm:Float, stressPa:Float}

types.name: ToolingManifest
types.doc: Portable neutral artifact inventory; file IO and hashing belong to its producer.

types.name: PanelAssemblyPlan
types.doc: Neutral reference checks and graph ordering. All blocking relations come from 3D sweeps.

fields.name: removalOrder
fields.doc: A -> B means B must be removed before A. Deterministic Kahn ordering.

types.name: PanelBlockingRelation
types.doc: A geometric observation supplied by machinekit.tooling, never inferred from datums.

types.name: PanelCodec
types.doc: Strict exact local-part recipe, separate from occurrence placement and qualification.

fields.name: cutterFit
fields.doc:
Positive curvature is an internal stock corner for a CCW removed region.
Rebate corners on/outside the blank are open approach boundaries.

types.name: PanelContours
types.doc: Single exact-contour boundary used by CAD, drawings and the future CAM bridge.

fields.name: relievedRectangle
fields.doc: Exact boundary of a rectangle union four corner circles; no overlapping loops.

fields.name: relievedPolygon
fields.doc: Integrate circular overcuts at concave right-angle roots into the outside loop.

types.name: PanelCoupon
types.doc: Neutral fit coupon: a shared plug and slots marked by total fit allowance.

types.name: PanelJoints
types.doc: One constructor owns both finished mating geometries and their assembly datums.

types.name: PanelOperation
types.doc:
One CAM operation, with finished geometry and an explicit setup/tool. No compensation.
Rebate is a pocket with an open side. Drill contours are exact circles.

types.name: PanelPlan
types.doc:
Local part only; its one outside-profile operation owns the exact outline.
Placement/removal belongs to the assembly. Stock Z spans [0, measuredThickness].

types.name: PanelStockSpec
types.doc:
Measured stock for a tooling recipe; all lengths are mm.
materialSpec is a supplier/design reference, not an implicit MaterialLibrary registration.
The selected contact face must be oriented explicitly by the later panel planner.

types.name: AggregateGate
types.doc: Aggregate-related recipe terms; these are not full reinforced-concrete code checks.

fields.name: evaluate
fields.doc:
Same-assembly gaps have no spacing floor. Their recess access uses the
existing exact fill topology, including owner-attributed trapped pockets.

types.name: CastabilityAnalysis
types.doc:
Cheap screening over exact shared section/fill records. No CFD, adhesion,
geometry edits or duplicate sweep solver.

fields.name: sourceReview
fields.doc: Source-only screening shared by design diagnostics and the mold review.

fields.name: apply
fields.doc:
Explicitly accepted mapped edit, returned as a detached source revision.
Unsupported mappings never become guessed source edits.

types.name: CastabilityProposal
types.doc:
A review alternative, never an applied edit or a claim of a routed vent.
Dimensions and locations are finished geometry in mold coordinates, mm.
Unknown parameter mappings remain explicit; the source design owns acceptance.

types.name: CastingProcessAnalysis
types.doc: One source-bound fill, geometric screening and supplier-datasheet pass.

fields.name: sectionLimit
fields.doc:
A certified diameter interval is enough to evaluate a section limit.
This does not make the box-only section/junction solvers support other geometry.

types.name: CastingProcessSpec
types.doc: In-memory process choices; shop records belong to the delivered package.

types.name: CompoundThicknessLimit
types.doc:
The supplier specifies a full section limit or a poured-layer limit.
No thermal conductivity, kinetics or heat-transfer data are inferred.

types.name: ExactFillBackend
types.doc: Native exact fill at the same critical levels used by the box path.

types.name: FillAnalysis
types.doc:
Exact rectilinear event-plane analysis. Air connectivity is evaluated in the
right-hand limit at each critical height: boxes ending there disappear,
surviving boxes retain their limiting volume. No offset height or pose sampling.
Positive-area faces connect cells; edge/point contacts never vent a pocket.

fields.name: analyze
fields.signature: (sourceId:String, sourceFingerprint:String, processFingerprint:String, region:Array<MoldBox>, boundaries:Array<FillBoundary>, cores:Array<FillCore>, fillHeightMm:Float, densityKgM3:Float, gravityMps2:Float, ?pourRate:Float, ?airEscapeWidth:Float, ?extraLevels:Array<Float>, ?fillObstructions:Array<MoldBox>, ?panels:Array<FillPanel>):FillReport

types.name: FillPocketGeometry
FillTooling
types.doc:
Orthogonal material projection. Curved openings are never credited without
an exact model: affected footprints stay blocked and explicitly Unsupported.

types.name: JunctionThickness
types.doc:
Largest Euclidean inscribed sphere in an exact orthogonal union. Exposed
rectangles are exact. Branch-and-bound uses the 1-Lipschitz distance field;
every live cell retains an upper bound, including when the budget is exhausted.
Numerical diameter tolerance is not a recipe/process acceptance threshold.

types.name: OrthogonalSections
types.doc:
Coordinate-compressed rays span the entire material interval between opposite
physical faces. Boolean partition sizes are never mistaken for wall thickness.

types.name: PourMixerSpec
types.doc:
Usable wet-mix mass, with sequential mixing, transfer and pouring.
Working time runs from the start of mixing. Parallel mixers need another model.

types.name: PourPlanning
types.doc:
Uses the existing corrected fill curve, not another geometry/fill pipeline.
These are planning checks; the process pipeline retains fill, compound and physical
qualification checks. No supplier mix ratio, mixer or working time is defaulted.

types.name: ProcessSpecs
types.doc: Value checks and explicit copies for in-memory process choices.
